purpose: Shows brief notifications in a corner of the screen. Place one ToastRegion at the app root and call toast({ title, description, tone, action }) to show a message.

props.name: placement
props.description: Corner the toasts stack in. Defaults to bottom-end

whenToUse: For short confirmations after an action: saved, copied, sent
For an undoable action, with an Undo action
whenNotToUse: For errors the user must act on — use Banner or Modal
For information that must stay visible — use Banner
antiPatterns: More than one ToastRegion in an app
Essential information that disappears before it can be read

anatomy: A fixed region in a corner; each toast is a square card with a tone edge, icon, title, optional description, optional action and a Close IconButton
states: Tone edge and icon in `color-text-info`, `color-text-success`, `color-text-warning` or `color-text-danger`
motion: Enters with `motion-easing-enter` over `motion-duration-overlay`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: The region is a landmark; F6 moves focus to it
Toasts time out after 6 seconds, paused while hovered or focused; toasts with an action never time out (WCAG 2.2.1)
Each toast is announced; Close is always available
